welcome.title: Let's protect your files.
welcome.description: Pick what matters, choose where it's stored, and lock it with a password. Your first backup starts in about two minutes.

folders.title: What should we protect?
folders.description: We've ticked the folders people can least afford to lose. Change the selection to fit you.
folders.empty: We couldn't find your usual folders. Add the ones you want to protect.
folders.dialogTitle: Choose a folder to back up

storage.title: Where should your backups live?
storage.description: A backup only helps if it survives whatever happens to this computer.

points.offsite: Safe even if this computer is lost or broken

cloudblink.fits: Your {{size}} fits with room to spare.
cloudblink.exceeds: Your selection ({{size}}) is larger than the {{storage}} available. You can pick fewer folders or upgrade later.

custom.title: My own storage
custom.description: An external drive, a NAS, S3, Backblaze, SFTP and more. Free forever, with a few extra steps to connect it.
custom.note: No account needed. You can add one later for email alerts and syncing your setup.

storage.signInHint: You'll sign in or create a free account in your browser.

provider.title: Choose your storage
provider.description: Pick where BlinkDisk should send your encrypted backups.

config.title: Connect {{provider}}
config.description: These details are encrypted with your password before they're saved.

password.title: Create your encryption password
password.description: Your files are locked on this computer before they go anywhere. Only this password opens them, so nobody else can read your backups. Not even us.

warning.title: There is no password reset
warning.description: We never see this password, so we can't recover it. Save it in a password manager or write it down now.
warning.confirm: I've saved my password somewhere safe

running.title: Your first backup is running
running.description: The first backup is the big one. After this, BlinkDisk only uploads what changed, so backups take moments.
running.background: No need to wait. BlinkDisk keeps working in the background, even if you close this window.

done.title: Your files are protected
done.description: Everything is encrypted and stored safely. You don't have to remember to back up again.
done.next: Backs up your changes every day, automatically
done.restore: Open any folder to browse its backups and restore files

issue.title: Your backup needs attention
issue.description: Some files couldn't be backed up. Open BlinkDisk to see what happened and run the backup again.

paused.title: Your backup was interrupted
paused.description: BlinkDisk closed before your first backup finished. Nothing was lost. It picks up where it left off.

error.title: We couldn't start your backup
error.description: Nothing was lost. Try again, or open BlinkDisk and add your folders from there.

account.description: Want an email if a backup ever fails?

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.detail: Only your password can open it

presets.history: Keeps older versions of your files
